contamination_risks: The prior 32 evaluated trials are adverse history and enter every cumulative correction.

family_contract.entry_rule: After an as-filed verified positive year-over-year EPS event, require the frozen reaction gap and close confirmation; rank at the completed reaction close and enter the next session open.
family_contract.exit_rule: Exit at the structural stop or the close of the frozen second or fifth holding session, whichever occurs first.
family_contract.expected_holding_behavior: Long at the session open after a completed bullish reaction, protected by completed ATR14, for at most five sessions.
falsifiers: selection-aware statistical rejection across all 64 attempts
any alteration or omission of a prior selection path
family_contract.material_difference_rationale: The prior exact search was independently underpowered with at most seven OOF fills per trial. V13 preserves its exact reaction-confirmed 32-trial grid on 1,063 point-in-time, date-symbol-disjoint 2012-2014 events and carries all prior trial statistics into cumulative selection correction.
family_contract.mechanism: Positive year-over-year quarterly EPS change can continue to reprice after a completed bullish reaction session because institutional interpretation and position building are gradual.
family_contract.primary_outcome: Selection-adjusted chronological account log growth after costs.

prior_selection_lineage.cumulative_pbo_method: concatenate matching parameter OOF paths across disjoint corpora

production_compatibility_risks: Live filings require exact acceptance and same-accession identity.
Fresh quote, spread, depth, halt, tradability, news, protection, and account reconciliation remain mandatory.
family_contract.ranking_rule: Highest EPS change ratio, then reaction-session dollar volume, then lexical symbol; maximum one family entry per day.

selection_accounting.cumulative_pbo_method: concatenate matching parameter OOF paths across disjoint corpora

family_contract.selection_rule: The complete new 32-trial family uses frozen DSR and Holm corrections across 64 current-plus-prior trials, cumulative PBO from matching parameter paths concatenated across the disjoint OOF corpora, plus neighbor, stress, and account gates.
family_contract.stop_rule: Place the frozen ATR14 multiple below entry; gap-through exits at the observed open and same-interval ambiguity is stop-first.
